data.title: 英梨梨 · 果酱别涂到稿子上
data.description: 休息日的早餐摆在远离画稿的一侧。英梨梨拿着抹刀给吐司涂果酱，看你望向另一边的速写本，立刻把盘子推到你面前。
data.promptProse: Eriri stands at a kitchen counter in a pale blue shirt, jeans, and cream apron. She spreads berry jam onto toast with a blunt butter knife, then angles the plate toward the viewer with a slightly embarrassed glance. Morning light crosses the clean counter, away from a closed sketchbook.
data.animaCaption: The blunt spreader touches the toast on the plate; the closed sketchbook stays at the far end.
